item.title: GPT-6 for opening replies and reminders
item.summary: Murph uses GPT-6 Luna for quick opening replies and simple reminders, with GPT-6 Sol for reminders that need more context.
item.details: Managed check-ins and insights now use GPT-6 defaults. Existing OpenAI reminders already move to the corresponding GPT-6 model when they run; your conversation model and supported alternative-provider choices stay available.
